card.name: The word use after concomitant
card.fires_on: The word "use" right after "concomitant" in drug-interaction text. It also fires weakly on a sentence-ending period in a news caption.

modes.label: Concomitant use
modes.description: The noun "use" following "concomitant" at the start of an interaction statement or an "If concomitant use is warranted" clause.
modes.example: The concomitant<< use>> of benzodiazepines and opioids
